newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends slightly lower, hit by Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends slightly lower, hit by Dow.

text.p: Britain's leading stock index ended slightly lower on Friday after robust U.S. economic data knocked down the Dow industrials and offset the nearly nine percent jump in the shares of Lloyds TSB Group .
But investors focused heavily on the domestic front, ahead of the Bank of England's meeting next Wednesday and Thursday on interest rates. The FTSE 100 closed 8.2 points lower to 4,899.3.
Seventeen members of the FTSE 100 post results next week, a total weighting of 27 percent of the index, starting with British Airways , HSBC Holdings and Pearson Plc on Monday.
